units: asset-local tiles; +X = game +I, +Y = game -J, +Z = height in tiles; heading radians about +Z from +X
sampler: u = clamp((t - seg.t)/seg.dur); v = (ease === "linear" ? u : u*u*(3-2*u)); p = from + (to-from)*v; p.z += arc * (mode === "quad" ? 4*u*(1-u) : 16*u*u*(1-u)*(1-u))
note: Every route starts and ends at the blueprint entry tile — no teleport. Walk speed 0.6 tiles/s over the authored connector-deck graph.
